complete_new_conflict_cohort.caveat: 44 object-frame conflicts are 43 frames, with repeated adjacent-frame tokens; not 44 independent events.

F1821_two_depth_clusters.mechanism: The old F2 selected component already contained both clusters. All 52 added points join the higher cluster: lower count stays20; higher count14→66. Median changes cluster, while MAD falls17.6733→10.7270mm.
F1821_two_depth_clusters.interpretation: Largest sorted gap is a deterministic descriptive partition, not physical fish/background labeling. Lower cluster is not automatically the fish.
F1821_two_depth_clusters.graph_execution: Formal DS5 whole-census selected/support/30mm/60mm graph diagnostics are assigned to root and not run here.

low_retention.definition: F6 selected_n / F2 original raw exclusive_valid_n <0.25 on all S available objects; no reference qualification or outcome filtering.
low_retention.caveat: raw_valid_retention alone does not identify background; original valid fish outside the source mask and missing raw values are outside this denominator.

proposed_diagnostic_sample.selection_policy: Complete44 new conflicts + complete9 zero-fish + earliest8 raw-retention<.25 per segment +9 named known regressions, deduplicated with all stratum tags retained.
proposed_diagnostic_sample.controls: For every base object choose a deterministic nearest same-segment stable F2/F6 both-compatible control; record source area and reference-state differences, deduplicate control IDs.
proposed_diagnostic_sample.control_status_rule: Use explicit reference_status equality. If exact reference_usable equality is required, four zero-fish cases with unusable references cannot have both-compatible controls: record NO_MATCH, never interpret null as compatible.
proposed_diagnostic_sample.area_rule: Use continuous source area distance in the frozen deterministic ordering; do not add a tuned area tolerance.
proposed_diagnostic_sample.outcome_boundary: This is a deliberately enriched exposed diagnostic cohort, not a new blind validation sample or a population prevalence estimator.

reviewed_minimal_formal_diagnostics.census: All original28382 masks and frozen F2/F6 selections, not just successful repairs or wide-mode cases.
reviewed_minimal_formal_diagnostics.baseline: Original selected8-connected components and original closing-support8-connected components; keep their actual sample/missing counts separate.

reviewed_minimal_formal_diagnostics.report: Show all thresholds/transform-grid outputs and raw counts. A depth graph split indicates lack of continuity at the chosen Z difference, not a physical fish surface boundary.
reviewed_minimal_formal_diagnostics.rejection_cost: Any future abstention proposal must first show coverage and lost original samples on the full fixed census; no rejection or mode selection is authorized by this review.
avoid: hide small modes or fill closing holes
reviewed_minimal_formal_diagnostics.synthetic_controls: Known same-depth component with missing bridge; known adjacent two-depth blocks with30/60mm boundary crossings; connected depth gradient; unchanged identity transform and explicitly shifted copies. These validate diagnostics, not physical calibration.
reviewed_minimal_formal_diagnostics.runtime: Existing local NumPy/OpenCV and stdlib, no new dependency/GPU/API; root measures actual whole-census runtime.

falsifiable_questions.question: Does closing support combine raw selected subgraphs separated by gaps or depth discontinuities?
falsifiable_questions.evidence: Full selected/support/depth-edge census comparisons; F1821 preserves a254.875mm distribution gap while counts change20/14→20/66.
falsifiable_questions.failure_to_support: Broad-support connectivity and mode counts may remain unchanged in most conflicts; do not universalize F1821.

falsifiable_questions.question: Are general new conflicts driven by expanding sampling into higher-Z locations rather than isolated multimodality?
falsifiable_questions.evidence: All39 originally compatible available cases expand; all medians increase, median displacement11.535mm.
falsifiable_questions.failure_to_support: A depth increase can reflect a valid slanted/curved fish surface; physical per-pixel identity remains unknown.

falsifiable_questions.question: Do image-coordinate surface features fail to overlap the supplied source silhouette under the recorded transform?
falsifiable_questions.evidence: Fixed full transform grid and raw spatial displays without choosing a best offset from masks or proxy scores.
falsifiable_questions.failure_to_support: Visual or contour overlap cannot by itself establish underwater extrinsics, true registration or physical surface identity.

independent_physical_label_boundary.current_reference: Postseal RGB manual-silhouette raw-depth core consensus; can contain background, other fish, alignment error or same-sensor anomalies.
independent_physical_label_boundary.decisive_missing: Independent pixel-level fish/background/other-surface correspondence and calibrated spatial registration are absent.
independent_physical_label_boundary.required_for_physical_claim: Independent surface anchors or annotations with uncertainty/UNKNOWN preserved; evidence beyond the same RGB silhouette projected into the same depth plane.
independent_physical_label_boundary.raw_lineage: BAG/native byte equality and exact source-index reprojection validate provenance and recorded equations, not actual underwater physical alignment.
independent_physical_label_boundary.mask_scope: Mask-contained filtering cannot recover a physically corresponding depth surface lying outside that mask.
independent_physical_label_boundary.followup: Review frozen diagnostic images/graph outputs, then plan independent surface/registration labeling; do not fabricate physical labels or automatically insert a selected mode into tracking.
